svg.title: One prompt, many requests
svg.desc: Bar chart of input tokens per model request for one prompt. Claude Code made 4 requests growing from 42,583 to 46,597 tokens (179,640 in total); Codex made 6 growing from 16,637 to 21,116 (115,385 in total); most of every request was read from cache.

g.text: Same prompt and demo repo, one run each, 10 Nov 2026. It shows the loop, not which tool is better.
